tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm off-white in light, warm near-black in dark.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Quiet panels, quote blocks and table stripes that sit on surface-100.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs and the recorder frame. Always paired with a hairline border.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy, headings and numerals on surface-100, surface-200 and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, labels and secondary copy on surface-100, surface-200 and surface-raised.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card borders. Carries no meaning on its own.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and secondary buttons, and the timer track. Meets 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: The one accent. Fill for the primary button, the current take and the timer's progress mark.

tokens.name: on-coral
tokens.usage: Text on a coral fill. White in light, dark ink in dark.

tokens.name: coral-text
tokens.usage: Coral used as text or an icon on surface-100, surface-200 or coral-soft: text buttons, warnings, a score that went down.

tokens.name: coral-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a Notice and of the 10 to 12 minute target zone. Text on it is ink or coral-text.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: A score or metric that improved, always beside an up arrow and a signed number. Text on surface-100 and surface-raised.

tokens.name: take-a
tokens.usage: Take 1 in the compare chart; Take 2 is coral. Meets 3:1 on surface-100.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every surface.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Page title: Rubric, Practice, Results, Compare, History.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small uppercase labels such as MEASURED and AI COMMENT.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: The overall score on Results and Compare.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Words per minute, filler rate, elapsed time.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a number and its unit.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a control group.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding of a row or an input.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding and the mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page top and bottom padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Quote blocks and chart bars.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, notices.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and the recorder frame.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Timer track and waveform marks.
